title: Settings Profiles
description: Quick saving and switching of settings profiles
body:
# Settings Profiles
Just a little mod for saving and swapping your game settings. This simple mod lets you save different configurations for your graphics, controls, and more. You can switch between them instantly without having to change every setting manually.


## Features:
- Quick Switch: Instantly load your favorite settings with one click.
- Easy Sharing: Right-click any profile to copy and share it with friends.
- Simple Import: Paste someone else's settings directly into your game.
- Fast Cleanup: Delete profiles quickly with a middle-click or a button.
